title: Arcane Tanker
summary: Arcane Tanker is an Arcane Enhancement that provides additional Armor for 60 seconds upon equipping an Archgun.
extract:
Arcane Tanker is an Arcane Enhancement that provides additional Armor for 60 seconds upon equipping an Archgun.
Can be sold for  ‍1,000.

Effect

Acquisition
Awarded from Arbitrations missions.
Can be purchased from the Arbitrations vendor in the  Arbiters of Hexis room in Relays for 10  Vitus Essence.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Notes
The additional armor is not affected by mods and is additive to total armor. For example, a  Chroma with a max rank  Steel Fiber, and active Rank 5  Arcane Tanker will have an armor rating of:Base Armor × (1 + Armor Mods) + Arcane Tanker = 350 × (1 + 1.0) + 1200 = 1,900 armor

Tips
As Arcane Tanker increases total armor, it can significantly boost any ability that relies on total armor, when casting while under its effect. These include:
 Rhino's  Iron Skin, which can be further amplified with  Ironclad Charge.
 Atlas'  Tectonics and  Rumblers
 Frost's  Snow Globe
 Gara's  Mass Vitrify
 Nezha's  Warding Halo
